env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC access, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This generation eval composes VIOS, RT-CV, RT-Embed, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and the Search behavior-analytics path as a delta on the current `search` developer profile. The build label is `in-3`, never a Compose profile. Agent/UI/ingress, Phoenix, the Search query API, and LLM/VLM NIMs are explicitly excluded.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build under `_builds/in-3/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand video ingestion, RT-DETR object detection and tracking on RT-CV, and video/frame embeddings on RT-Embed. Keep media retrievable through VIOS. Publish detection metadata and embeddings to Kafka and store both in Elasticsearch." Offer both live RTSP via NvStreamer and static VIOS upload, target `{{platform}}`, validate, and do not deploy.
